question: Guru Nanak Jayanti is observed annually on the full moon date of which month in the Hindu calendar?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kartik**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The celebration of** Gurpurab**, also called** Prakash Utsav**, honors the **birth of Guru Nanak**, the first Sikh guru.
 
• It is **celebrated **on the **Full Moon Day (Pooranmashi or Purnima)** of the** Lunar Month** of **Kartik**.
 
• **Guru Nanak**, the **founder of Sikhism** and one of the most well-known and significant Sikh gurus, is held in the highest regard by the Sikh people.
 
• One of the holiest holidays in Sikhism is this one. The **anniversaries of the ten Sikh Gurus** serve as the focal point of Sikh celebrations.
 
 
• The Gurus were in charge of forming the Sikhs' beliefs. The **Sikhs celebrate their birthdays**, known as **Gurpurab**, with prayers and festivities.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Guru Nanak** : The **first Guru and founder of Sikhism**, **Guru Nanak Dev Ji**, was born in the **Punjab **region of the Indian subcontinent in the village of **Talwandi **in **1469**. Located close to Lahore in modern-day Pakistan, the village is currently called **Nankana Sahib**.

 
 
• **Mehta Kalu ji**, the **father **of Guru Nanak Dev ji, worked as a local accountant. It was said about his **mother**, **Mata Tripta ji**, that she was a modest and deeply pious person.
 
• In his early twenties, Nanak moved to Sultanpur, an important town on the main road between Lahore and Delhi, where he worked as a clerk in the Lodi administration.
 
• When he was **about thirty years old**, he had an experience that he described as a revelation—a **direct encounter with God** that shaped the rest of his life.
 
• The** stories** Sikhs later told **about Guru Nanak**, called **janam sakhis**, recount his childhood inwardness along with his engagement with social issues.
